text:
maria: incident-bot fired for prod-ingest but pages not making it to oncall. noticed ~18m with no ACKs from the paging system. seeing a bunch of 401s in the notifier logs. anyone oncall?

jamal: i'm oncall, looking. can you paste the relevant log lines?

maria: pasted below (sanitized) — looks like auth failures when the notify service calls pagerflow: 
```
POST /v1/pages 401 Unauthorized {
  "msg": "signature mismatch",
  "request_id": "req_9f3a"
}
```

rory: ugh signature verification? did we rotate the paging signing key earlier today? ops-deploy-bot ran a key-rotate at 15:02.

ops-deploy-bot: key-rotate: pagerflow-signing-key rotated by @svc-deploy at 2026-03-17T15:02Z.

jamal: that would explain 401s. notify service still using old key. pushing a hotfix now to load new key from secret-manager.

elaine-csm: heads up — support got 2 escalations about slow responses from customers in EU region, maybe related. I'm telling them we're triaging.

maria: confirming symptom: automatic incident channel automation (incident-bot) didn't post followups or escalate because messages never acknowledged by the paging-layer, so oncall didn't get page and the usual fallback didn't trigger.

rory: do we have fallback configured? i thought we had manual fallback to email after 10m. looks like the fallback job polls page delivery status but it also depends on the same auth token.

jamal: timeline: key rotated 15:02Z, error spike from 15:03Z onward, customers reported between 15:18-15:30Z. i have a patch building, switching notify to read latest signer from secrets and refreshing cached signer immediately. will roll to prod in 2-3m and force a retry of undelivered pages.

maria: i'll trigger manual pages to oncall after jamal's deploy if needed. also switching incident-bot to quiet-mode to avoid duplicate automations.

ops-deploy-bot: deploy started: notify-service hotfix (load-rotated-key) by jamal. build 2026.3.17.482.

jamal: rolled hotfix to 3/3 notify instances. forcing cache purge: `curl -X POST https://notify.internal/_admin/refresh-keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer admin'`

rory: after refresh we see 200s to pagerflow and pages being queued. great. re-triggering pending pages via internal script: `scripts/retry_pending_pages --service prod-ingest`

maria: manual confirm: 4 pages retried, 3 acknowledged by oncall, 1 still pending (we're pinging them).

elaine-csm: i'm telling support to inform the two affected customers; we'll offer a postmortem / SLA credit if needed. need incident severity?

maria: proposing P2 since paging failed and some customers were impacted, but system recovered in ~20m with manual retries.

jamal: root cause: out-of-band key rotation (ops-deploy-bot) updated pagerflow signing key but notify-service cached old key and had no automatic hot-reload for signer. mitigation: hotfix to refresh on key-change events + alert on repeated 401s to paging endpoint. will add a canary test post-rotation to validate end-to-end.

rory: followups: (1) add rotation playbook to avoid silent auth breaks, (2) make fallback path not depend on same signing key, (3) add an incident-bot heartbeat so channel automation raises if no ack for X minutes.

maria: adding tasks to the incident ticket and assigning owners. jamal will own hotfixes + canary, rory will own fallback redesign, elaine will coordinate customer comms.

elaine-csm: thanks — i'll draft comms and loop in account owners.

jamal: closing loop: monitoring shows normal delivery rates now. will follow up with a short retro in SRE channel in 2h.

maria: great, marking this thread resolved for now. :thumbsup:
